issues.problem: In the rendered head the vault strip inboard of the grille is still 0.92 of the cove band and ends at only 0.79 at the crest. The photos show 0.78-0.83 next to the grille, falling to 0.56-0.64.
issues.fix: 74a8cd0 (baked x0.85..0.66, eFn 0.03+0.04*exp) should be rendered and measured first. If the strip next to the grille is still above 0.85, drop the eFn inboard glow to 0.02+0.03*exp(-(xg-ax)/0.18) and take the baked multiplier at t=TROUGH.ts[0] to 0.80.
